name: Textarea
description: Multi-line text field. Optional auto-grow and monospace modes.
whenNotToUse: Rich text editing — use a dedicated editor and theme it with ayywi tokens.

classes.ayy-textarea--autosize: Grows with content (CSS field-sizing). Falls back to fixed height.

a11y: Label it (Field + Label), same as Input.
do: Set rows for a sensible starting height.
dont: Don't disable resize on non-autosize textareas; users need it.
